subject.title: Memory MVP: add ingestion helpers and CLI/skill surface

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a first-class default remember/recall/review/edit/forget memory facade now, route this to plugin/ClawHub surfaces, or wait for companion schema/provenance/write-flow decisions first?
rationale: The current code has overlapping memory surfaces, but the requested facade depends on durable schema, provenance, review/edit/forget semantics, and the special memory plugin slot rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep as MVP design work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the operator-surface tracker until schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget contracts converge, then build the smallest default facade.

options.title: Route to plugin first
options.body: Treat external memory plugins or ClawHub skills as the intended home unless a missing SDK seam is identified.

options.title: Close into companion issues
options.body: Close this only if maintainers decide the command facade should be decomposed entirely into the open schema, provenance, write, and review-flow issues.

recommendation.title: Keep as MVP design work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the operator-surface tracker until schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget contracts converge, then build the smallest default facade.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the strongest current-main code-history signal for the memory CLI/plugin surface being reviewed.
